greet.text: Mm. A visitor on this cold ledge. I was an Elder of the Azure Cloud Sect once, before I gave my seat to younger hands. Now I wait for the snow and the end, in that order.

choices.label: Senior, how long do you have?
Brew him tea and listen to his stories. (3 days)
Ask him about the Flowing Water Sutra.
Ask what he would pass on.
Ask if the mountain wants anything from him.
Bring the three Cold Iron Gu asked for.

time.text: Thirty winters, perhaps. Core Formation gave me five hundred years and I spent most of them on sect politics. Do not repeat my mistake, young one.

stories.text: ...and that is how Yun's master lost his left ear to a Frost Ape. Ha! Your qi settles when you listen; good.

lingzhi.text: A thousand-year root, for an old stump like me? It will not buy me a century, but it eases these bones. I will remember this.

water.text: Water does not fight the stone; it outlives it. Sit by the falls with me and I will show you its first three currents.

not_yet.text: What I hold would crack a Qi Refining dantian like an egg. Lay your Foundation first, then come back. If I am still here.

inheritance.text: Foundation Established. Good, you came in time. Take these. A longevity pill I hoarded for myself, and my insights on Core Formation. Do not waste five hundred years.

choices.label: Kneel and accept his legacy. (7 days)
Tell him to keep the pill and live a while longer.

refuse.text: Stubborn child. Then take only the words, and know that an old man will watch the snow a little longer because of you.

demonic.text: Your qi reeks of other men's blood. I am old, not blind. I have one strike left in me; do not make me spend it on you.

choices.label: Strip the dying elder's hut while he meditates.

rob.text: He does not open his eyes. 'Take it,' he says. 'Heaven keeps the ledger, not me.' The words follow you down the mountain.

errand_ask.text: My old sword-stand has rusted through. Three lumps of cold iron from the crystal vein would let me forge a new one, and my hands remember how. Bring them and I will give you something for the trouble.

errand_thanks.text: Cold and true. Hm. Here is a palm technique I used to part the clouds before a battle: Cloud-Parting Palm. Study the manual, and let some qi settle in you while you listen.
